FIND-001 (iteration 1) resolved: the new `_access_checking_x_ok(is_executable_fn)` helper's inner `fake_access(path, mode)` asserts `mode == os.X_OK` on every call before delegating to `is_executable_fn(path)`. It is genuinely wired into `mock.patch("os.access", side_effect=_access_checking_x_ok(...))` in all 3 tests that need a meaningful (non-constant) os.access fake: test_which_miss_falls_back_to_first_existing_known_good_path (line 58), test_which_miss_prefers_local_bin_over_homebrew_when_both_exist (line 91), and test_which_miss_skips_candidate_that_exists_but_is_not_executable (lines 112-116) — not defined-and-unused

manually traced the mutation `os.X_OK -> os.F_OK` (or os.R_OK) through test_which_miss_skips_candidate_that_exists_but_is_not_executable: fake_isfile returns True for both known-good candidates; the loop reaches the first candidate (~/.local/bin/claude), calls os.access(candidate, <mutated mode>); _access_checking_x_ok's assert `mode == os.X_OK` fires immediately with an AssertionError inside the mock's side_effect, which propagates out of `_resolve_claude_bin()` and fails the test before any assertion on `result` is even reached. The same mutation is independently caught earlier in test_which_miss_prefers_local_bin_over_homebrew_when_both_exist (line 91, first os.access call on the first candidate) and in test_which_miss_falls_back_to_first_existing_known_good_path (line 58, on the one candidate that exists). Confirmed: at least one test (in fact three) now fails under this mutation — the gap FIND-001 identified is closed

additionally traced an `and`->`or` mutation and a candidate-list traversal-order mutation (e.g. `reversed(_CLAUDE_BIN_KNOWN_GOOD_PATHS)`) through the same test file: both are caught by test_which_miss_skips_candidate_that_exists_but_is_not_executable (result value mismatch under `or`) and test_which_miss_prefers_local_bin_over_homebrew_when_both_exist (result value mismatch under reversed order) respectively — the suite is not narrowly patched to only the one specific mutation named in FIND-001
